title: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 Review | Bandar Lampung
meta_description: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 review: about 3,000 runners in Bandar Lampung on 20 September, run by Indonesia's state railway for its 81st anniversary.
dek: Indonesia's state railway staged a half marathon in Bandar Lampung on 20 September 2026 to mark its 81st anniversary. Here is what the race was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: The Locomotive Half Marathon is a corporate anniversary race, run by the Tanjungkarang regional division of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) [1]. The 2026 edition, on Sunday 20 September, drew about 3,000 people: the public, state-company and government staff, running clubs, railway enthusiasts, and disabled runners who were invited to take part [1]. It offered 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races, plus a 3 km for disabled participants, with the half marathon off first at 5am [1]. It suits you if you are in Lampung and want a well-staffed local race with an unusual crowd. It is not a destination event.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: About 3,000 people took part in Bandar Lampung on Sunday 20 September 2026 [1]. The event marked the 81st anniversary of KAI and of the Indonesian armed forces (TNI) [1].

The field was deliberately mixed. It brought together the general public, employees of state-owned companies, ministries and local government, business partners, running communities, railfans, and invited disabled participants [1].

sections.heading: Distances and Start Times
paragraphs: There were three main distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km [1]. The 21 km went first at 5am, the 10 km at 5.30am and the 5 km at 5.45am, and disabled participants ran a 3 km that started at 6am [1].
A 5am start for the half marathon matters: most of the 21 km field will finish before the sun is high. Plan to be at the start well before five.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you live in or near Lampung, yes. It is a sizeable local event with the resources of a state company behind it, and the organisers said they coordinated with the relevant authorities on safety, security and comfort [1]. The inclusive 3 km category is a good reason to bring along friends or family who would not run a 5 km.

If you are travelling from elsewhere in Indonesia, weigh it as a corporate celebration rather than a runners' race. The reporting describes a celebration of partnership, not the course, water stations or timing, so check what the organiser publishes about those before you commit.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Locomotive Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: About 3,000 people took part in Bandar Lampung on Sunday 20 September 2026, including members of the public, state-company and government staff, running communities, railway enthusiasts and invited disabled participants. The event marked the 81st anniversary of the state railway KAI and of the TNI.

faqs.question: What distances does the Locomotive Half Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: In 2026: a 21 km half marathon starting at 5am, a 10 km at 5.30am and a 5 km at 5.45am, plus a 3 km category for disabled participants that started at 6am. All were held in Bandar Lampung, Lampung province, Sumatra.

faqs.question: Who organises the Locomotive Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), Indonesia's state railway company, through its Regional Division IV Tanjungkarang. Its executive vice president described the event as combining sport tourism, education about sustainable transport and a healthy lifestyle.
